meta.name: ingest
meta.description: Fetch requested source material and prepare sourced engagement updates. Use to catch up from external notes or messages; applying updates requires a bound record and confirmation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取指定的笔记与消息,整理成带出处的进展更新
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要从聊天记录和笔记里整理项目进展
copy.tagline_en: Pull in notes and messages, then draft sourced progress updates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn chats and notes into project updates

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会去抓取你指定的来源材料,并整理出一份带来源标注的参与度更新草稿。没有绑定记录时也可以先准备提案,但真正应用更新需要绑定记录并确认。
howto.when: 当你想从外部笔记或消息里补上进度、并准备带来源的更新时会触发。若由 @fde 调用,它复用那份已脱敏的 packet 和范围,不重新开始设置与提问。

say.text: 从这些外部笔记里抓材料,整理一份带来源的更新草稿

say.text: 从这段消息里补上最近的进展

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude fetches the source material you name and prepares sourced engagement updates. It can draft a proposal without a bound record, but applying updates requires a bound record and confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to catch up from external notes or messages and prepare a sourced update. If called by @fde, it reuses that run's sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or questions.

say_en.text: Pull material from these external notes and draft a sourced update
say_en.note: A draft can be prepared without a bound record
Needs a bound record and confirmation

say_en.text: Catch me up from this message
